pattern: repeated edit across many files: one t3_code_run script
experience: Asked to rename a function across 12 modules and change a constant, Claude ran sed -i and perl -pi one-liners, and on macOS retried after sed's \b matched nothing.
rule: t3_code_run: use it for a change repeated across many files; prefer JavaScript to sed or perl one-liners.
